name: Damaged Hazmat Suit
text: A patched protective suit that shrugs off most radiation but little else.
source: CARDS p.45; COST Damaged Hazmat Suit; ERR p.16; ERR p.20 (v2)

name: Sturdy Leather Armor
text: Layered hide and stitched plates; decent against blades and beams, useless against radiation.
source: CARDS p.46; COST Sturdy Leather Armor

name: Aviator Cap
text: A worn flight cap that only a Super Mutant head can use; adds a little padding and sharper senses.

name: Patched Three-Piece Suit
text: Mended formal wear that makes its wearer look sharp and read a room.
source: CARDS p.48; COST Patched Three-Piece Suit

name: T-60 Power Armor
text: A heavy powered frame. Its green side is the powered state with full armor and strength; the yellow side is the unpowered fallback.
source: CARDS p.62; COST T-60 Power Armor
